verified_facts.text: The Ranch at Rock Creek is set in a secluded valley in Montana, on a 19th-century homestead.
verified_facts.excerpt: Secluded in one of Montana's most pristine valleys, The Ranch at Rock Creek's 19th-century homestead thrives in balance with its diverse eco-system.

verified_facts.text: The Ranch is all-inclusive, so guests can leave their wallets behind.
verified_facts.excerpt: grounded in its all-inclusive design, allowing guests to leave their wallets behind

verified_facts.text: Stays include breakfast, lunch, social hour and dinner of farm-to-table ranch cuisine.
verified_facts.excerpt: Farm-to-table Ranch cuisine: breakfast, lunch, social hour, and dinner.

verified_facts.text: Twice-daily activities are included in the stay.
verified_facts.excerpt: Twice-daily activities are included in your stay.

verified_facts.text: All-inclusive rates provide equipment, gear and knowledgeable guides for morning and afternoon excursions.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our all-inclusive rates provide equipment, gear and knowledgeable guides that prepare guests for excursions each morning and afternoon.

verified_facts.text: Guests have four miles of private access to Rock Creek for fly fishing.
verified_facts.excerpt: With four miles of private access to Rock Creek, guests can learn on some of the best fishing locations in the world.

verified_facts.text: Year-round activities include horseback riding, the gun ranges and wildlife viewing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Year-round activities include horseback riding, our gun ranges, wildlife viewing, and so much more.

verified_facts.text: Winter excursions include ice skating, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling and sledding.
verified_facts.excerpt: Experience our exciting all-inclusive winter excursions such as ice skating, cross-country skiing, snowmobiling, or sledding.

verified_facts.text: Accommodations range from lodge suites and a converted historic barn to luxury log homes and canvas glamping cabins.
verified_facts.excerpt: Whether you choose a lavish lodge suite, converted Historic Barn accommodation, spacious luxury log home or canvas glamping cabin

verified_facts.text: The original 19th-century barn was restored into three accommodations: Loft, Stables and Wrangler.
verified_facts.excerpt: This original structure housed stables, a tack room and a hay loft, which have been lovingly restored into three unique accommodations, Stables, Wrangler and Loft.

verified_facts.text: The glamping cabins are made of canvas, wood and stone, set on the banks of Rock Creek.
verified_facts.excerpt: These “canvas cabins” are comprised of canvas, wood and stone, designed for sustainability, with minimal impact on the environment and the wildflower meadows surrounding the creek.

verified_facts.text: Trapper cabin has a cedar soaking tub for stargazing.
verified_facts.excerpt: Stargaze from your cedar soaking tub beneath a glistening nightscape.

verified_facts.text: Trapper is the Ranch's most secluded accommodation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Trapper is our most secluded accommodation.

verified_facts.text: Homesteader wagons, covered conestoga wagons, can be added to accommodations in summer.
verified_facts.excerpt: Drift off to sleep and back in time in a covered conestoga wagon.

verified_facts.text: The Granite Lodge is built and decorated in the style of the great National Park lodges.
verified_facts.excerpt: the Granite Lodge, built and decorated in the style of the great National Park lodges

verified_facts.text: Lodge rooms have custom-made furniture, woven textiles, frontier antiques and lavish linens.
verified_facts.excerpt: Our lodge rooms are appointed with custom-made furniture, woven textiles, frontier antiques and lavish linens.

verified_facts.text: The Spa at Rock Creek treatments include access to the cedar sauna and relaxation area.
verified_facts.excerpt: Treatments include access to the cedar sauna, shower facilities and relaxation area.

verified_facts.text: The outdoor heated pool is open in summer and the hot tub is open year-round.
verified_facts.excerpt: Cool off in 25,000-gallon outdoor heated pool in the summer. Relax in the hot tub year-round as you gaze at the views and twinkling stars.

verified_facts.text: Evening entertainment in the Silver Dollar Saloon includes billiards, karaoke, a private movie theater and four lanes of bowling.
verified_facts.excerpt: Evening entertainment in the Silver Dollar Saloon, including billiards, poker table, shuffleboard, karaoke, table tennis, private movie theater, board games, four lanes of bowling

verified_facts.text: The Silver Dollar Saloon is named for the money embedded in the bar.
verified_facts.excerpt: Saddle up to saloon, named for the money embedded in the bar.

verified_facts.text: The Ranch has a kids club called Flint's Forest Rangers.
verified_facts.excerpt: Flint's Forest Rangers Kids Club

verified_facts.text: Bikini Beach features docks in summer and skating in winter.
verified_facts.excerpt: Gaze upon this pristine setting featuring docks in the summer and skating in the winter.

verified_facts.text: Bluebird cabin has a king canopy bed, a cedar sauna and a heated screened porch.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enjoy a king canopy bed, state-of-the-art electronics, a large bathroom featuring a cedar sauna and a heated screened porch.

verified_facts.text: Classic Canvas Cabins are open in spring, summer and fall.
verified_facts.excerpt: Classic Canvas Cabins are open in the spring, summer and fall.

verified_facts.text: Homesteader wagons are available mid-May through Labor Day.
verified_facts.excerpt: Available mid-May through Labor Day.
